competitor_advantages.point: Envysion combines intelligent video with expert human audits as a loss-prevention service, aimed at reducing employee theft, cash shrinkage, and POS fraud at the store level.

latest_cos_commentary.headline: Envysion, now part of Motorola Solutions, provides AI video-based loss-prevention and operations intelligence to QSR operators.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: No direct product overlap with Genius's core lines; relevant only where a restaurant's POS-transaction data is cross-referenced with video for loss-prevention audits (an integration/partner conversation, not head-to-head competition).
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Envysion continues to market AI-driven video verification (Smart Site Protection) as a 2026 differentiator for reducing false alarms and POS fraud.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Not typically a POS/payments displacement conversation; if it surfaces, it's usually as a video-surveillance vendor a restaurant already has, which can integrate with (not replace) a POS system.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Motorola Solutions ownership is sourced from a third-party aggregator, not confirmed via an original Motorola Solutions press release, in this pass.
